rows.grounds: compound denoting the east reference line
locative indicating placement in the eastern portion
locative indicating placement toward the north
locative indicating the period of the sun's northward movement

items.question: Where must the eastern reference line be placed during the sun's northern course?
premises: The eastern reference line is located in the eastern part.
A contrasting placement is specified for the northern course.
During the northern course the placement shifts to the northern side.
items.inference: Therefore, during the northern course the eastern reference line is to be placed in the northern part.
uncertainties: The exact spatial or diagrammatic referent of prācīsūtraṃ depends on the broader ritual or astronomical context.
items.plain_english: The eastern line is in the eastern part, but during the northern course it is in the northern part.
